summary_zh: 提供自然语言目标，由策略选择操作与页面编号元素来驱动浏览器；支持 CLICK、TYPE_TEXT、SELECT、滚动、等待、DONE 等操作，仅当操作为 TYPE_TEXT 时用小模型生成文本。示例包含 Google Flights 搜索与打开维基百科条目，并附本地检查器查看决策过程。
audience_zh: 适合想了解或试验浏览器智能体实现、关注基于结构化页面元素而非截图决策的开发者；也适合需要按 README 示例跑通演示、研究单次请求完成操作与目标选择机制的技术人员。

evidence.quote: > **Jev Ultrafast is now ultrafast mode in [Browser Use](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use).** Same idea, built in: the agent acts on numbered page elements. Browser Use also handles long multi-step tasks.
Give it one goal. [TypeSafe's Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction) picks an operation and an element. A small LLM writes text only when the operation is `TYPE_TEXT`.
The operations are `CLICK`, `TYPE_TEXT`, `SELECT`, `SCROLL_UP`, `SCROLL_DOWN`, `WAIT`, `DONE`, and `BLOCKED`. Only supported operations and targets are offered.
**Zürich → London on Google Flights in 7.1 seconds.** One natural-language goal, actual text generation, and loading waits included.
